about: Labeled chats for the chat history tools (chats_search, chats_read). {{secret:NAME}} is replaced at run time with a generated credential of that shape, so no token-shaped literal is committed. Markers in ALL CAPS must never reach a tool result.

entries.text: Which port should the staging proxy listen on? 443 is already taken by nginx on that box.
Use 8443 for the staging proxy. It keeps TLS on a well-known alternate port and does not clash with nginx.
Good, go with 8443 and put it in the deploy config.
Done. deploy/staging.toml now sets listen_port = 8443 and the health check points at /readyz.
Clean up the old staging hosts, the proxy there is not used anymore.
Removed three idle hosts. The legacy proxy on port 9000 is gone.
The users table migration hangs in CI after ten minutes.
It waits on a lock held by the long running backfill job.

entries.summary: Root cause: the backfill held an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on users, so the migration waited. Fix: batch the backfill in chunks of 1000 rows and run the migration first.

entries.text: Ship the batched backfill.
Merged. CI passes in four minutes now.
Should the logo be orange or purple?
Neither fits the achromatic chrome. Try graphite.
Final call: the logo is graphite on paper, no accent color.

Design a token bucket rate limiter for the gateway.
A token bucket refilled at 120 requests per minute per key, burst 20, keyed by API client id.
The bridged spawn test is flaky under load, it times out.
The daemon shares the test's process group, so the sigkill reaches the test runner. The fix is to start the daemon under setsid.
Apply the setsid fix.
